cloud-init.user-data:
#cloud-config # ============================================================================== # STRUCTURA FACTOR - Ubuntu 24.04 Server cloud-init # ==============================================================================
# --- Locale --- locale: pl_PL.UTF-8 timezone: Europe/Warsaw
# --- Keyboard --- keyboard: layout: pl variant: ''
# --- Users --- users: - name: structura sudo: ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL groups: docker, sudo shell: /bin/bash lock_passwd: true ssh_authorized_keys: - ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIIEFVWX/rOhf742cdesRaoBNCmAUeLFS3kJbcXgzkxBi hermes@structura
# --- Network --- network: version: 2 ethernets: eth0: dhcp4: true dhcp6: true
# --- SSH --- ssh_pwauth: false disable_root: true ssh_port: 2222
# --- Package update --- package_update: true package_upgrade: true
# --- Packages --- packages: - openssh-server - ca-certificates - curl - gnupg - lsb-release - ufw - fail2ban - samba - cifs-utils - htop - tmux - unzip - git
# --- Runcmd --- runcmd: # SSH port change to 2222 - sed -i 's/^#Port 22/Port 2222/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config - sed -i 's/^Port 22/Port 2222/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config - echo 'Port 2222' >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config - systemctl restart sshd
# UFW firewall - ufw --force reset - ufw default deny incoming - ufw default allow outgoing - ufw allow 2222/tcp - ufw allow 80/tcp - ufw allow 443/tcp - ufw allow from 192.168.0.0/16 to any port 445 proto tcp - ufw --force enable
# fail2ban - | cat > /etc/fail2ban/jail-local.conf << 'F2BEOF' [sshd] enabled = true port = 2222 filter = sshd logpath = /var/log/auth.log maxretry = 3 bantime = 3600 findtime = 600 F2BEOF - systemctl enable fail2ban - systemctl restart fail2ban
# Create structura directories - mkdir -p /opt/structura/appdata/hindsight/{pgdata,pgdump} - mkdir -p /opt/structura/appdata/hermes/{memories,skills,session} - mkdir -p /opt/structura/appdata/n8n/config - mkdir -p /opt/structura/appdata/npm/{data,letsencrypt} - mkdir -p /opt/structura/appdata/portainer - mkdir -p /opt/structura/appdata/duplicati - mkdir -p /opt/structura/appdata/homepage/icons - mkdir -p /opt/structura/appdata/searxng - mkdir -p /opt/structura/appdata/telegram - mkdir -p /opt/structura/ai-workspace/{STRUCTURA,Sprawy,_trash} - mkdir -p /opt/structura/backups/{appdata,ai-workspace,pgdump,pgdata} - mkdir -p /opt/structura/repos - chmod 750 /opt/structura/appdata - chown -R 1000:1000 /opt/structura/appdata
# SMB share - | cat >> /etc/samba/smb.conf << 'SMBEOF'
[ai-workspace] path = /opt/structura/ai-workspace browseable = yes read only = no valid users = structura create mask = 0660 directory mask = 0770 SMBEOF - (echo "structura"; echo "structura") | smbpasswd -a structura -s - systemctl enable smbd - systemctl restart smbd
# Signal that cloud-init is done - touch /opt/structura/.cloud-init-complete
# --- Write files --- write_files: - path: /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/structura.conf content: | Port 2222 PasswordAuthentication no PubkeyAuthentication yes PermitRootLogin no MaxAuthTries 3 LoginGraceTime 30
# --- LUKS (optional - enabled by -EnableLUKS in setup.ps1) --- # If LUKS is enabled, setup.ps1 will run cryptsetup commands via SSH after VM is up. # cloud-init only prepares the packages: # packages: # - cryptsetup # runcmd: # - apt-get install -y cryptsetup
cloud-init.network-config: version: 2 ethernets: eth0: dhcp4: true dhcp6: true
